title: The Locked Door
tagline: const, and the promises a class keeps
hints: `Pack(size_t capacity)` only needs to store the capacity - the vector starts empty on its own.
`add` must check `full()` FIRST and return false without touching the vector. A method that half-succeeds is worse than one that refuses.
`drop` needs a hand-written search: walk the vector by index, and when `items_[i] == item`, erase it with `items_.erase(items_.begin() + i);` then `return true;` immediately.
`list()` returns a string. Join with `, ` BETWEEN items - the usual trick is `if (i > 0) out += ", ";` before appending item i.
`report` takes a `const Pack&`, so every method it calls must be const. If the compiler complains about that, you have found a method missing its const - that is the floor working as intended.
